name: Schretstaken (Germany)
description: Green field with a narrow yellow stripe near the top and bottom edges, charged towards the hoist with the municipal arms of Schretstaken (a boar beneath a tree with a wavy bend on yellow and green).
history: Municipal flag of Schretstaken; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Schretstaken arms — boar, tree and wavy bend
